001package org.clafer.ir;
002
003import org.clafer.common.Check;
004import org.clafer.domain.Domain;
005import org.clafer.domain.Domains;
006
007/**
008 *
009 * @author jimmy
010 */
011public class IrSingleton extends IrAbstractSet {
012
013    private final IrIntExpr value;
014
015    IrSingleton(IrIntExpr value, Domain env, Domain ker) {
016        super(env, ker, Domains.OneDomain);
017        this.value = Check.notNull(value);
018        if (ker.size() > 1) {
019            throw new IllegalArgumentException();
020        }
021    }
022
023    public IrIntExpr getValue() {
024        return value;
025    }
026
027    @Override
028    public <A, B> B accept(IrSetExprVisitor<A, B> visitor, A a) {
029        return visitor.visit(this, a);
030    }
031
032    @Override
033    public boolean equals(Object obj) {
034        if (obj instanceof IrSingleton) {
035            IrSingleton other = (IrSingleton) obj;
036            return value.equals(other.value) && super.equals(other);
037        }
038        return false;
039    }
040
041    @Override
042    public int hashCode() {
043        return 511 * value.hashCode();
044    }
045
046    @Override
047    public String toString() {
048        return "{" + value + "}";
049    }
050}
